## Invitations

The outreach programme issued 6884 invitations during the reporting period. A total of 5070 people attended, representing an attendance rate of 73.6 per cent. The results indicate that most invitees engaged with the opportunity to attend. The invitation process was supported by direct communication and follow-up activity to maintain awareness and encourage attendance.

Operational arrangements were adapted to local access conditions. Van days were maintained where roads allowed, helping to support delivery of the outreach activity. This approach enabled the programme to continue while recognising practical travel and access considerations.

## Contact

SMS messages were sent to 5806 invitees. Reminder messages were also sent to 5806 invitees, providing a consistent follow-up contact across the invited group. These communications supported the invitation process and helped keep the outreach activity visible to recipients.

The report was prepared by G. Evans.
